notes.title: QoL improvements, bug fixes, and made the game easier.
notes.notes:
Just kidding. I didn't make the game easier.

But the following changes were made:

[list]
[*] Color balancing of the light background.
[*] Better text rendering.
[*] Loot screen bug fixes when using the gamepad.
[*] Volume preferences saved.
[/list]
